items.name: Survey chapter card
items.description: Drifting topographic contour lines behind a chapter card, with a folio row, a big numeral, a two-line title, a pinging map marker and a chapter rail.

items.name: Overprint stat slide
items.description: A "12×" counts up beside two dithered, misregistered ink discs on paper, with a claim, before/after bars and a source line.

items.name: Rag archive quote
items.description: A customer quote on moving cotton-rag paper, with archive film mounted like a print, a serif pull quote and the attribution.

items.name: Survey lower third
items.description: A speaker's name tag over interview footage: a small contour-shader panel with the name, role and a pinging marker.
